name: 01833 · Georgetown, MA
findings: ZIP 01833 (Georgetown) has 29 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (21%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01833 (Georgetown) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
